2607.03971.title: Order-based Causal Discovery for Multistage Processes
2607.03971.paper_summary: Causality has become an increasingly important tool for gaining a deeper understanding of complex systems. Among various causal analysis methods, causal discovery, which identifies causal relationships among variables from data, has been widely used to uncover underlying causality in diverse processes. However, while multistage processes are prevalent in many fields, existing causal discovery methods may produce counterintuitive results, given the known process knowledge, and may not be computationally efficient for handling large datasets typical of multistage processes. To address this gap, we propose a novel causal discovery method called Order-based Causal Discovery for Multistage Processes (OCDM). OCDM is designed to infer the causal structure of multistage data while preserving their inherent hierarchical and sequential structure by explicitly incorporating process knowledge into the causal discovery process. Specifically, we propose a structural knowledge-informed order-inferring algorithm that infers the causal order of variables by incorporating information about the stage from which each variable originates, based on an order-based causal discovery framework naturally suited for inherently ordered multistage data. Furthermore, to eliminate spurious edges from the initial causal graph generated based on the inferred causal order, we introduce a novel pruning technique using stochastic gated neural networks, which offers greater computational efficiency compared to existing methods. Through experiments on various datasets, we demonstrate that OCDM effectively infers the causal structure of multistage processes, outperforming existing methods.
2607.03971.paper_summary_zh: 因果關係已成為深入理解複雜系統的重要工具。<lb/>在各種因果分析方法中，因果發現從數據中識別變量之間的因果關係，已被廣泛用於揭示各種過程中的潛在因果性。<lb/>然而，儘管多階段過程在許多領域中普遍存在，現有的因果發現方法在已知過程知識的情況下可能會產生反直覺的結果，並且在處理典型於多階段過程的大型數據集時可能不具計算效率。<lb/>為了解決這一問題，我們提出了一種新穎的因果發現方法，稱為多階段過程的基於順序的因果發現（OCDM）。<lb/>OCDM旨在推斷多階段數據的因果結構，同時通過明確將過程知識納入因果發現過程來保留其固有的層次和順序結構。<lb/>具體而言，我們提出了一種結構知識驅動的順序推斷算法，通過納入每個變量來源的階段信息，推斷變量的因果順序，這基於一種自然適合固有有序多階段數據的基於順序的因果發現框架。<lb/>此外，為了消除基於推斷的因果順序生成的初始因果圖中的虛假邊緣，我們引入了一種使用隨機門控神經網絡的新型修剪技術，這相比於現有方法提供了更高的計算效率。<lb/>通過對各種數據集進行實驗，我們證明了OCDM能有效推斷多階段過程的因果結構，並超越了現有方法。
